create_eagle_verify_input: create an EagleVerifyInput dataclass instance with draft tokens, custom masks, and attention retrieval indices for speculative verification
create_idle_eagle_verify_input: create an idle EagleVerifyInput with empty tensors and specified topk, spec_steps, and num_verify_tokens parameters
prepare_eagle_verify_batch: prepare a ScheduleBatch for verification by allocating KV cache slots and assigning request-to-token pool mappings
verify_accepted_tokens: verify and find accepted tokens from draft predictions using greedy or tree speculative sampling against target model logits
create_eagle_draft_input: create an EagleDraftInput dataclass with hidden states, verified token ids, and attention arguments for the draft extend phase
filter_draft_batch: filter an EagleDraftInput batch by new indices, optionally with strict length checking for topk and hidden state tensors
merge_draft_batches: merge two EagleDraftInput batches by concatenating hidden states, verified ids, and topk tensors along the batch dimension
